description: This file defines the Config_File class, which provides functionality for reading, parsing, and managing configuration files with support for sections, variables, multiline values, and options such as overwriting variables and handling hidden sections. The class includes methods for loading files, retrieving configuration data, and parsing file contents.

classes.name: Config_File
classes.description: A class for reading and parsing configuration files, supporting sectioned configs, variable management, and options for handling hidden sections and multiline values.

methods.name: Config_File
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the Config_File object, optionally setting the configuration path.

methods.name: set_path
methods.description: Sets the directory path where configuration files are located.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves configuration data from a file, section, and variable, returning values accordingly.

methods.name: get_key
methods.description: Retrieves configuration data based on a combined key in the format 'file/section/var'.

methods.name: get_file_names
methods.description: Returns a list of all loaded configuration file names.

methods.name: get_section_names
methods.description: Returns a list of section names within a specified configuration file.

methods.name: get_var_names
methods.description: Returns variable names from a file or a specific section.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears loaded configuration data for a specific file or all files.

methods.name: load_file
methods.description: Loads and parses a configuration file into the class, optionally prepending the configured path.

methods.name: set_file_contents
methods.description: Sets configuration content directly from a string for manual parsing.

methods.name: parse_contents
methods.description: Parses configuration source contents into internal data structures, supporting sections, variables, multiline values, and options.

methods.name: _set_config_var
methods.description: Internal method to set a variable in a container, handling options for overwriting and boolean conversion.

methods.name: _trigger_error_msg
methods.description: Internal method to trigger PHP warnings or errors with a message.
